text:
Aisha Khan: Finalizing v0.11 changelog + whats-new page. I put a draft under /whats-new/v0.11-staging. Need one pass for SDK snippets, link sanity, and the Known Issues callout.

Tom Reed: Skimming now. Do we want a small migration note for customers using the older "responses.stream" helper? I can add a one-liner.

Aisha Khan: Yes please. Something like: 'If you use responses.stream, see Migration: streaming API (breaking change in 0.11) for the new event model and idempotency keys.' Keep it short and link to the migration guide.

Rina Gupta: I updated the JS snippet to the new streaming events shape and added an inline example for handling partial outputs. Snippet: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
for await (const evt of client.responses.stream({ prompt: 'Summarize Q2' })) {
  if (evt.type === 'delta') process.stdout.write(evt.delta.text);
}
```

docs-bot: linkcheck: PR #4599 -> 3 redirects found, 1 broken (/guides/old-stream -> /guides/streaming, /sdk/node -> /sdk/js).

Marco Silva: I'll open a redirect PR for /guides/old-stream. Also noticed the embed migration anchor is missing from the embed guide, submitting a tiny anchor fix.

Tom Reed: Copy suggestion: in whats-new bullet that reads 'Better routing across capacity tiers' -> change to 'Routing: improved cost-aware routing across Dedicated and Hosted tiers'. More descriptive.

Aisha Khan: Agreed, update it. Also include the estimated token cost reduction: 'typical 8-18% cost reduction on chat-heavy workloads (varies)'.

Rina Gupta: Quick question on code block style: should Python examples use the new responses client or the older generate endpoint? The SEMANTICS doc recommends responses API.

Aisha Khan: Use responses API. Add a short compatibility note: 'For older generate users, see migration/legacy-generate'.

Tom Reed: Small nit: the Known Issues section mentions 'duplicate tokens may appear in low-latency streams'  can we add a troubleshooting step: 'set retry_on_error=false for streaming client to avoid duplicate replays while we patch runtime'?

Aisha Khan: Add the troubleshooting step but soften the wording: 'temporary workaround: disable automatic client-side retries during streaming sessions'.

docs-bot: CI: docs build succeeded at 2420001480. Preview published to staging.

Marco Silva: I validated the snippets render in staging and anchors resolve after redirect PR merged.

Rina Gupta: Did a final copy-edit pass. Removed passive voice in the feature bullets and trimmed the TL;DR.

Aisha Khan: Thanks all. Merging the staging -> prod deploy now after a 15min bake. Will post the prod link when done.

docs-bot: prod deploy complete at 2420001575. What's New: https://docs.redwood.com/whats-new/v0.11.

Tom Reed: Spot-checked the prod page, code highlighting is fine. Leaving thread open for 24h to catch any post-publish reports.

Aisha Khan: Closing for now. If anything pops up, open a new thread with "v0.11-postpublish" in the title. :white_check_mark:
